# Odiche Obiakarije: Forward Deployed Engineer, Enterprise AI

> Portfolio of Odiche Obiakarije (Odi), a Forward Deployed Engineer at NICE (Cognigy)
> who embeds with enterprise teams to design, build and hand over conversational and
> agentic AI, on 5+ years of data engineering, RAG and multi-agent work.
> The site has two sides: professional and personal.

## Professional (https://odiobiak.github.io/website-me/)
- Experience:
  - Forward Deployed Engineer, NICE (Cognigy), Jul 2026 to present. Lead engineer on a
    multimodal AI agent for new auto insurance quotes at a Fortune 500 insurer, built as
    the reference architecture for its production build: hybrid LLM + code architecture,
    chat-to-voice switching with no lost context, document intelligence (up to 30 of 37
    answers from one upload), 750+ regression checks, 33 simulated personas, voice quote
    cut from 49 to 36 turns. Also a personal AI agent prototype over the Personal Agent
    Protocol, and a root-cause investigation into empty LLM responses in a live voice agent.
  - Data & AI Engineer, Accenture, Dec 2020 to 2026. Multi-agent RAG assistant (~60%
    faster Q&A), metadata evaluation agents (40% fewer integration errors), streaming ETL
    for real-time traffic data (35% fewer errors, 60% less manual work).
- Case studies (each with an architecture diagram), deep-linkable as #case-<id>:
  1. case-quote: Multimodal AI Agent for Auto Insurance Quotes (NICE Cognigy, GPT-4.1,
     Webchat and WebRTC voice, document vision, versioned rules layer of 79 fields).
  2. case-pap: Personal AI Agents over the Personal Agent Protocol (PAP 0.2), a prototype:
     signed assertions, DPoP key-bound tokens, device sign-in with per-scope consent, a
     conversation route and an MCP tools route; impostors and stolen tokens refused;
     58 spec checks, 0 failures.
  3. case-rag: Multi-Agent Rebate Q&A Assistant (LangChain, Pinecone, GPT-4o).
  4. case-automation: Metadata Quality Agents (rule checks + LLM judge, human review).
  5. case-pipeline: Real-Time Traffic Data Pipeline (Kafka, Airflow, PySpark, Postgres).
- Toolkit: Cognigy.AI, Voice Gateway, WebRTC, MCP, A2A, Personal Agent Protocol,
  LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Snowflake, Databricks, Kafka,
  PySpark, Airflow, dbt, AWS, Azure, OAuth 2.0, DPoP, Python, SQL, JavaScript,
  TypeScript, Node.js.
- Certifications: Snowflake SnowPro Core; Claude Architect (Foundations, Anthropic).
- Education: B.S. Computer Science, University of Pittsburgh (2019).
- Live AI assistant "Odi" answers questions about this work.
